description: This PHP source file defines a REST API class for managing Performance Trackers within the OrangeHRM system. It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting performance tracker records, along with related validation rules and metadata.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing Performance Tracker entities, supporting operations such as list, create, retrieve, update, and delete.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all performance trackers with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new performance tracker record.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerParams
methods.description: Utility function to set PerformanceTracker entity parameters from request data.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the getAll() method's parameters.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified performance tracker records.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validation rules for delete method parameters.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Fetches a single performance tracker record by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validation for retrieving a single record.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing performance tracker.
